questions.question:
A # B means 'A is brother of B'

A @ B means 'A is the daughter of B'

A & B means 'A is the husband of B'

A % B means 'A is the wife of B'

A * B means 'A is the son of B'

If A & D @ Q * B * K, then how is D related to K?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 %
 *
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Husband

 
 Wife
 Son
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given : A & D @ Q * B * K

So,

 
• A & D → A is the husband of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cece344dd166ee548a3dcb02b56e18752d54db0bb5f7fce642bee954312c70d.png] 

 
• D @ Q → D is the daughter of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c713228beb4fa32d0a5625a93bfdc89cc584073bc6a13ac83720176f44dd83d.png] 

 
• Q * B → Q is the son of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00350f0548336fe42bf6d803d54bbc83845f43f055d4ecc7ff8729eba04ab225.png] 

 
• B * K → B is the son of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/331d79a39faee34168e2120e2c4da8e0663ba607a630da8c258929422f85b25b.png] 

 

Thus, according to the final family D is the great granddaughter of K.

Hence, "**Great Granddaughter**" is the correct answer.

Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered 1, 2 and 3. Considering the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically follows from the statements.

**Statement****:**

Some bats are balls.

Some balls are rings.

There is no ring bell.

**Conclusion****:**

1. No bell is ball.

2. No ring is bat.

3. Some balls are bats.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16cba1070229080265f378d79babab23514730e948fa394fa415bd2081fb6aee.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No bell is ball → Does not follow (As some balls are rings and there is no ring bell. So, no definite relation is given between bell and ball, therefore no bell is ball can be possible but not definitely true)

II. No ring is bat → Does not follow (As some bats are balls and some balls are rings. So, no definite relation is given between ring and bat, therefore no ring is bat can be possible but not definitely true)

III. Some balls are bats → **F**ollow (As some bats are balls, it gives some bats are also balls)

∴ Here, Only conclusion 3 follows.

Hence, "**Only conclusion 3 follows**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven persons E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight line facing north. K sits third to the left of H. No one is sitting between F and I. H sits fourth to the right of J. No one is sitting to the right of I. F sits third to the right of E. Who is sitting third from the right end of the row?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Seven persons E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting in a straight line facing north. 

**Explanation :**

1) No one is sitting to the right of I.

2) No one is sitting between F and I.

3) F sits third to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/004bef0a88bfe1dd9811382f608e6a2ea5f1a3abd672adc4423b0db741c7fba5.png] 

4) H sits fourth to the right of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ddfda2fe761b0c290e6d73bc636175c1938e81d3cdae4fde89eca18e824636.png] 

5) K sits third to the left of H.

After positioning K only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff678f12c4376e67b2334fd8af5f93436a8a59634a7781a720acb625f6c1b2f.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement H is sitting third from the right end of the row.

Hence, **"H"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option which is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words are to be treated as meaningful words and not related to each other on the basis of number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word.)

Scientist : Laboratory :: Astronomer : ?
questions.solution:
Logic : Professional : Workplace associated

So,

__
 
• Scientist works in a laboratory.

Similarly,

 
• Astronomer works in an observatory.

Hence, "Observatory" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Profession → A paid occupation, especially one that involves prolonged training and a formal qualification.
 
• University → A professor works in an university.
 
• Environment → the surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
 
• Observatory → It is a place or building equipped and used for making observations of astronomical, meteorological, or other natural phenomena.
